title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第十二章、熟悉的成都

    邓艾和钟会的关系不好，钟会知道邓艾不喜欢他，他也不喜欢邓艾。
    钟会听说邓艾觉得自己是攻破蜀国大门功劳最大的人，不仅住进了蜀国皇宫，还把自己当成了蜀国的新皇帝，于是问姜维：“伯约，你觉得邓艾这个人是福还是害？”
    姜维说：“现在邓艾的功劳比你大，地位比你高，可能还有造反之心，迟早会杀了你。”
    钟会点头同意，正想和姜维商量怎么办，这时收到了司马昭的信。原来司马昭也听说了邓艾在蜀国的事情，也认为邓艾有造反之心，邓艾一直留在蜀国不回来，就是想做蜀国的新皇帝。司马昭写信给钟会就是命令钟会去成都抓邓艾。
    钟会眼里闪着激动的光：“这信来得正是时候，伯约，你和我一起去成都！”
    姜维笑了笑。带钟会去成都，这是救国计策的第一步。
    第二天，钟会带兵去成都。到城外后，他听姜维的建议，不把自己到成都的消息告诉任何人，然后找来皇宫的守卫，让守卫天黑后带自己的人进皇宫，等晚上邓艾睡着了就抓人。事情很顺利，当天晚上邓艾就在睡梦中被抓了。邓艾被抓后，他带来的魏军和蜀国投降的蜀军全都成了钟会的人。第二天早上，两支军队和全城的百姓站在城门口欢迎钟会入城。
    钟会看着那热闹的人山人海，对身边的姜维笑道：“伯约，这是我这一辈子最快乐的时刻。”
    姜维看着熟悉的成都街头，无声而又悲伤地笑了。一个月前皇帝刘禅打开城门向邓艾投降的时候，满城百姓也是像现在这样欢迎邓艾入城的吗？这还是他熟悉的那个成都吗？
    突然，一块石头从街边朝姜维飞了过来。姜维立刻躲开了。
    “姜维，你这个坏蛋！你怎么能投降？你对得起诸葛丞相吗？”扔石头的是一个小男孩，他站在街边大声骂姜维。
    姜维没有动，脸上保持着微笑。
    “来人，去把那扔石头的小孩拿下！伯约，你没事吧？”钟会关心地问。
    姜维摇头道：“那就是一个孩子，和他生什么气呢？今天是你的好日子，不要杀人。”
    钟会挥了挥手，收回了抓孩子的命令。他看着落在地上的石头，叹息道：“伯约，你心里的苦，我都明白。”
    姜维有点儿震惊，但马上就笑了。他的苦，外人怎么会知道呢？
fullText.traditional:
第十二章、熟悉的成都

    鄧艾和鍾會的關係不好，鍾會知道鄧艾不喜歡他，他也不喜歡鄧艾。
    鍾會聽說鄧艾覺得自己是攻破蜀國大門功勞最大的人，不僅住進了蜀國皇宮，還把自己當成了蜀國的新皇帝，於是問姜維：“伯約，你覺得鄧艾這個人是福還是害？”
    姜維說：“現在鄧艾的功勞比你大，地位比你高，可能還有造反之心，遲早會殺了你。”
    鍾會點頭同意，正想和姜維商量怎麼辦，這時收到了司馬昭的信。原來司馬昭也聽說了鄧艾在蜀國的事情，也認為鄧艾有造反之心，鄧艾一直留在蜀國不回來，就是想做蜀國的新皇帝。司馬昭寫信給鍾會就是命令鍾會去成都抓鄧艾。
    鍾會眼裡閃著激動的光：“這信來得正是時候，伯約，你和我一起去成都！”
    姜維笑了笑。帶鍾會去成都，這是救國計策的第一步。
    第二天，鍾會帶兵去成都。到城外後，他聽姜維的建議，不把自己到成都的消息告訴任何人，然後找來皇宮的守衛，讓守衛天黑後帶自己的人進皇宮，等晚上鄧艾睡著了就抓人。事情很順利，當天晚上鄧艾就在睡夢中被抓了。鄧艾被抓後，他帶來的魏軍和蜀國投降的蜀軍全都成了鍾會的人。第二天早上，兩支軍隊和全城的百姓站在城門口歡迎鍾會入城。
    鍾會看著那熱鬧的人山人海，對身邊的姜維笑道：“伯約，這是我這一輩子最快樂的時刻。”
    姜維看著熟悉的成都街頭，無聲而又悲傷地笑了。一個月前皇帝劉禪打開城門向鄧艾投降的時候，滿城百姓也是像現在這樣歡迎鄧艾入城的嗎？這還是他熟悉的那個成都嗎？
    突然，一塊石頭從街邊朝姜維飛了過來。姜維立刻躲開了。
    “姜維，你這個壞蛋！你怎麼能投降？你對得起諸葛丞相嗎？”扔石頭的是一個小男孩，他站在街邊大聲罵姜維。
    姜維沒有動，臉上保持著微笑。
    “來人，去把那扔石頭的小孩拿下！伯約，你沒事吧？”鍾會關心地問。
    姜維搖頭道：“那就是一個孩子，和他生什麼氣呢？今天是你的好日子，不要殺人。”
    鍾會揮了揮手，收回了抓孩子的命令。他看著落在地上的石頭，嘆息道：“伯約，你心裡的苦，我都明白。”
    姜維有點兒震驚，但馬上就笑了。他的苦，外人怎麼會知道呢？

sentences.pinyin: jiāng wéi yáo tóu dào nà jiù shì yí ge hái zi hé tā shēng shén me qì ne jīn tiān shì nǐ de hǎo rì zi bú yào shā rén
sentences.english: Jiang Wei shook his head and said, “He’s just a child, why be angry with him? Today is your big day, don’t kill anyone.”

sentences.simplified: 钟会挥了挥手，收回了抓孩子的命令。
sentences.traditional: 鍾會揮了揮手，收回了抓孩子的命令。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng huì huī le huī shǒu shōu huí le zhuā hái zi de mìng lìng
sentences.english: Zhong Hui waved his hand, taking back the order to capture the child.

sentences.simplified: 他看着落在地上的石头，叹息道：“伯约，你心里的苦，我都明白。”
sentences.traditional: 他看著落在地上的石頭，嘆息道：“伯約，你心裡的苦，我都明白。”
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe luò zài dì shang de shí tou tàn xī dào bó yuē nǐ xīn li de kǔ wǒ dōu míng bai
sentences.english: He looked at the stone on the ground and sighed, “Boyue, I understand the pain in your heart.”

sentences.simplified: 姜维有点儿震惊，但马上就笑了。他的苦，外人怎么会知道呢？
sentences.traditional: 姜維有點兒震驚，但馬上就笑了。他的苦，外人怎麼會知道呢？
sentences.pinyin: jiāng wéi yǒu diǎn'r zhèn jīng dàn mǎ shàng jiù xiào le tā de kǔ wài rén zěn me huì zhī dào ne
sentences.english: Jiang Wei was quite shocked, but he immediately smiled. How could an outsider possibly know his pain?

sentence_translations: Chapter 12: Familiar Chengdu
Deng Ai and Zhong Hui did not have a good relationship.
Zhong Hui knew that Deng Ai did not like him, and he also did not like Deng Ai.
Zhong Hui heard that Deng Ai considered himself the person who contributed the most to breaking through the gates of Shu.
Not only did he move into the Shu royal palace, but he also regarded himself as the new emperor of Shu.
So he asked Jiang Wei, “Boyue, do you think Deng Ai is a blessing or a curse?”
Jiang Wei said, “Right now, Deng Ai’s achievements are greater than yours, and his status is higher than yours.
He may even have rebellious intentions. Sooner or later, he will kill you.”
Zhong Hui nodded in agreement. Just as he was about to discuss what to do with Jiang Wei, he received a letter from Sima Zhao.
It turned out that Sima Zhao also heard about Deng Ai’s actions in Shu and believed that Deng Ai had rebellious intentions.
Deng Ai stayed in Shu without returning because he wanted to become the new emperor of Shu.
Sima Zhao wrote a letter to Zhong Hui, ordering him to go to Chengdu to arrest Deng Ai.
Zhong Hui’s eyes gleamed with excitement: “This letter came at just the right time. Boyue, you and I will go to Chengdu together!”
Jiang Wei smiled. Taking Zhong Hui to Chengdu was the first step in the plan to save the country.
The next day, Zhong Hui led his troops to Chengdu.
After arriving outside the city, he followed Jiang Wei’s advice and did not tell anyone about his arrival in Chengdu.
Then he summoned the palace guards and instructed them to bring his men into the palace after dark.
They would capture Deng Ai while he was asleep at night.
Things went smoothly, and Deng Ai was captured in his sleep that night.
After Deng Ai was captured, the Wei army he brought with him and the surrendered Shu army all became Zhong Hui’s men.
The next morning, the two armies and all the city’s residents stood at the city gate to welcome Zhong Hui into the city.
Zhong Hui looked at the bustling crowd and said to Jiang Wei beside him with a smile, “Boyue, this is the happiest moment of my life.”
Jiang Wei looked at the familiar streets of Chengdu and smiled silently and sadly.
A month ago, when Emperor Liu Shan opened the city gates to surrender to Deng Ai, ..
.. didn’t the entire city’s residents welcome Deng Ai into the city in the same way?
Is this still the Chengdu he once knew?
Suddenly, a stone flew toward Jiang Wei from the side of the street. Jiang Wei quickly dodged it.
“Jiang Wei, you scoundrel! How could you surrender? Are you worthy of Chancellor Zhuge?”
The person throwing stones was a little boy, who stood by the street and loudly cursed Jiang Wei.
Jiang Wei didn’t move and kept a smile on his face.
“Someone, go and catch that child who is throwing stones! Boyue, are you okay?” Zhong Hui asked with concern.
Jiang Wei shook his head and said, “He’s just a child, why be angry with him? Today is your big day, don’t kill anyone.”
Zhong Hui waved his hand, taking back the order to capture the child.
He looked at the stone on the ground and sighed, “Boyue, I understand the pain in your heart.”
Jiang Wei was quite shocked, but he immediately smiled. How could an outsider possibly know his pain?
